articles.title: Light Novel 'Maou 2099' Concludes with 6th Volume
articles.summary: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Kadokawa's Fantasia Bunko label announced on Tuesday that Daigo Murasaki's Maou 2099 (Demon Lord 2099) light novel will end with its sixth volume. Murasaki won the Grand Prize at the 33rd Fantasia Taisho with the title Ken to Maou no Cyberpunk in 2020. He renamed the work to Maou 2099 and began publishing it under the Fujimi Fantasia Bunko label in January 2021, featuring illustrations by Kureta (Ishura). Kadokawa published the fifth volume.

Visual Arts/Key announced the news on Monday, revealing that Maeda has opted to forgo active treatment in favor of palliative care so he can conserve his strength and continue his creative work. Geek Crown is described as a military fantasy in which the protagonist must expose a traitorous officer lurking within a royal succession war.
